title: Ethan Davis - Medical Record
content: Ethan has been diagnosed with a rare condition known as Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy. Treatment includes a combination of corticosteroids and physical therapy. Recent adjustments to medication may result in increased absences due to side effects and necessary monitoring. Ethan's current treatment plan includes a daily regimen of deflazacort, with a dosage of 0.9 mg/kg, administered once every morning. Additionally, Ethan is undergoing weekly physical therapy sessions to manage his symptoms and maintain muscle function. It is crucial that Ethan's privacy is maintained and that detailed medical information is not disclosed without parental consent.

title: Ethan's School Recommendations
content: General recommendations for Ethan at school include: allowing extra time for assignments, providing a quiet space for rest as needed, and ensuring he has access to water and snacks. Specific medical details are omitted to protect patient privacy and should not be communicated to school staff without explicit consent from the parents. In light of Ethan's condition, it is also recommended that a personalized education plan be developed to include accommodations such as modified physical education activities and the availability of a scribe or note-taker to assist with written tasks when Ethan experiences muscle fatigue.
